source_visual_observations: Triangle ABC with whole angle B=35° and C=50°; bisector BD; AE perpendicular to BD at F; E on BC; segment DE.
audit.independent_solution: BD bisects B=35°, giving DBE=17.5°. Since AE is perpendicular to BD, AEB=72.5° and AEC=107.5°. With C=50°, EAC=22.5°. Reflection across BD exchanges A and E: B lies on the bisector and AE is perpendicular to it. Thus AD=DE, so ADE=180−2×22.5=135°. Since A,D,C are collinear, CDE=45°, choice C.
